comment: DirtBox - three distortion models in one effect plus an automatic noise reducer, mono. ACID = the gritty asymmetric distortion of 303 boxes (DS-1 type), RAT = after the ProCo RAT (gain only above ~70 Hz, treble falls as the gain rises, hard diode clip, Filter low-pass), METAL = after the Boss MT-2 Metal Zone (two clip stages, tight lows, -9 dB mid scoop at 750 Hz). ZNR listens to the clean input, measures the noise floor itself (capped at -60 dBFS) and gently expands the wet signal below it, holding 50 ms and releasing over 150 ms so kick tails fade naturally. Makeup keeps the wet near the input level whatever the Drive.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Model
params.comment: Distortion model: 0 ACID (303-box asymmetric grit, DS-1 type), 1 RAT (ProCo RAT), 2 METAL (Boss MT-2 Metal Zone). Changing it fades the wet back in over ~6 ms. Default ACID.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: Gain into the clipper, 0.5x at 0 up to the model's maximum at 100 (ACID 120x, RAT 300x, METAL 60x into a fixed 6x second stage), exponential. Makeup keeps the loudness roughly steady, so Drive mostly adds dirt. Default 50.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: 100 = brightest on every model. ACID: low-pass/high-pass crossfade at 600 Hz, flat at 50. RAT: the RAT Filter, one-pole low-pass 475 Hz..16 kHz. METAL: low-pass 1.2..12 kHz. Default 50.

params.name: ZNR
params.comment: Automatic noise reducer on the wet path. The threshold sits this far above the measured noise floor: +6 dB at 1 .. +24 dB at 100 (+15 dB at 50). The floor is capped at -60 dBFS so the threshold never climbs into the music. 0 = off. Default 50.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Wet output level, 0 .. 2x. 50 = about the input level (an input peaking near -14 dBFS comes out at about the same peak at any Drive).

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50 (parallel distortion: the clean kick stays under the dirt).

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
